bottleneck.description: Top-tier global supplier of fiber-optic gyroscope inertial navigation systems, with vertically integrated FOG manufacturing and trusted-by-70-navies status creating multi-year qualification switching cost in maritime/defense INS.

dependency.key_customers: 70+ navies and armies globally including French Navy, Spanish Forces, US Navy (subsea), European tactical drone programs (Airbus), satellite primes (Astrix series for spacecraft attitude control)
dependency.key_suppliers: Vertically integrated; designs and manufactures FOG coils, accelerometers, electronics and algorithms in-house; minimal external dependency for core IP

editorial.notes: Exail sits in a structural global top-3 FOG oligopoly with Honeywell and Safran (top 5 collectively ~70% of nav-grade revenue), and defense/space qualification creates prohibitive switching cost on awarded programs. However, this is a peer-competitive oligopoly — Honeywell, Safran, Northrop Grumman LITEF, and KVH all compete for new sockets, and ring-laser-gyro and MEMS IMU alternatives exist in lower-grade tiers. MEDIUM reflects real qualification moat consistent with structural-duopoly anchors but not a sole-source position.
